sources.snippet: Vision-language models (VLMs) pretrained on large-scale multimodal datasets encode rich visual and linguistic knowledge, making them a strong foundation for robotics. Rather than training robotic policies from scratch, recent approaches adapt VLMs into vision-language-action (VLA) models that enable natural language-driven perception and control. sources.title: SmolVLA - aegean.ai
sources.snippet: SmolVLA is Hugging Face's compact Vision-Language-Action model, built on top of the LeRobot library. It is designed to be small enough to fine-tune and deploy on a single consumer GPU, while remaining competitive with larger open VLAs on standard manipulation benchmarks.
